comment: The Claude directory edition of plugins/teable: main minus what the directory's policy scan refuses. scripts/build-claude-directory.mjs applies this to a checkout of main, and the publish-claude-directory workflow pushes the result to the claude-release branch, which the directory tracks. Everyone else (Codex, npx skills, installs from GitHub) reads main, which keeps everything. Refused on 2026-11-23: standalone AI media generation (media-guide) and scraping instructions read as bypassing site defences (scrape-guide, scrape.* mirrors). Every edit must match exactly once, so a reworded source line fails the build instead of shipping unfiltered.
